name: Felsőtárkány (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőtárkány (a quartered white and blue shield with a stag, a bird, a tree and a wavy stripe, bordered in yellow) below the name FELSŐTÁRKÁNY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
